text: The Oblivion Elemental is a void revenant located in the Vision of Orgrimmar.
The Obedient Phalynx is a phalynx located next to Pelodis in Bastion.
__NOTOC__ Observer Zelgar is a soul seeker located in the Soulforges in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Obsidian Colored Potion had its ID reused by the Potion of Hibernal Rest.
Obliterated Soul Shard was to be the objective of Obliterated Soul Shards.
Obscuring Essence Potions can occasionally be purchased in limited quantity from brokers in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Obedient Felhounds are felhounds located at Socrethar's Rise in .
Obolos is a Maw caster located in Gorgoa: River of Souls of the Maw.
There are several iterations of the Observational Records daily quest in Korthia, varying only by their location.
Obelisk of Dark Tidings drops from Xyraxz the Unknowable inside the Chamber of Wisdom in Korthia.
Observational Records are found in Observation Device doodads located at several locations of Korthia for the many versions of the Observational Records daily quest.

Obliterator Propellant drops from Kin'garoth in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Obsidian Citadel Necklace is looted from Icy Satchel of Helpful Goods.
The Obsidian Gravewing can be purchased from Chachi the Artiste in Sinfall for upon reaching 75 Renown (Shadowlands) with the Venthyr Covenant.
Obsidian Cores drop from geomentals and automa in Zereth Mortis.
Oblivion Crushers drop from Mythrax the Unraveler in Uldir. They are also looted from Cache of Uldir Treasures.

Obsidian Clumps drop primarily from fire elementals and magmammoths on the Dragon Isles.
Obsidian Armorers are black drakonid located in the Obsidian Enclave in Valdrakken.
Obsidian Guardians are black drakonid located in the Obsidian Enclave in Valdrakken.
The Obsidian Observer is a black whelp located in the Obsidian Enclave in Valdrakken. The whelp itself is observed by a nearby Blacktalon Watcher.
Obsidian Bladewings are black whelps located at the Obsidian Throne in the Waking Shores. They found circling Sabellian's side of the area.
Obsidian Protectors are black drakonid located at the Obsidian Bulwark at the Obsidian Throne in the Waking Shores.

Obsidian Egg Clutch is a toy rewarded from reaching Cohort with the Sabellian faction. As the name implies, it places a clutch of black dragon eggs at the player's location, three of which hatch into the whelps Rowdy, Onion, and Blitz. The whelps can be petted and played with, eventually leading to them casting Deep Breath and falling asleep then de-spawning.

__NOTOC__ Obsidian Seared Alloy is a crafting ingredient created with Dragon Isles Blacksmithing and made by smelting; taught by Plans: Obsidian Seared Alloy from the quest A Head For Metal. 2 bars are created at a time.
Obsidian Keymaster is an exploration achievement earned by turning in a total of 30 Obsidian Keys to individuals around the Obsidian Citadel.
Obsidian Champion is an exploration achievement earned by completing the following special encounters at the Obsidian Citadel and adjacent lava fields.
Obsidian Journal is an objective of Neltharus: Secrets Within.
Observational Report: Earthen is looted from an Ancient Volume in Uldaman: Legacy of Tyr.
Observant Riddles: A Field Guide is a book found near the Possessive Hornswog just east of the Ruby Lifeshrine on the Waking Shores.

Observing the Wind is available after reaching Renown level 6 with the Maruuk Centaur. This quest has no objectives; simply choose a reward and complete. The reward you didn't pick can be purchased from Quartermaster Huseng for 50 Dragon Isles Supplies.

The Obsidian Outcasts are a group of black dragonkin that banded together to work on odd jobs and eke out a living. They used to live in Dragonbane Keep, but when the djaradin resurfaced they stole their home from them. The Outcasts resolved to take their home back, and to that end conduct sieges. They periodically reclaim the keep, holding onto it and making it safe for their allies to traverse; though the djaradin tend to re-take the area, only for the Outcasts to re-group and siege it again.
The Observer's Locus is located in southern Antoran Wastes. The Observer's Locus Resonator is needed in order to open a portal to the area to fight Rezira the Seer.
Obsidian Outfitters are black dragonspawn located at the Obsidian Throne in the Waking Shores.

Obsidian Cape is available for purchase for from several vendors at the Obsidian Citadel while at True Friend standing with Sabellian and Wrathion: *Samia Inkling and Xaldrass (Sabellian) *Lorena Belle and Atticus Belle (Wrathion)

Obsidian Collar can be purchased from the following vendors for after reaching reputation "Friend" level with Wrathion or Sabellian: *Lorena Belle (Wrathion) *Atticus Belle (Wrathion) *Samia Inkling (Sabellian) *Xaldrass (Sabellian)
Obsidian Battle Horn is looted from a chest in the Zskera Vaults in the Forbidden Reach.
Object security traits are protections employed by user interface objects to restrict actions that can be taken by insecure code, such as addons.
Obsidian Mail Tunic is mail chest piece with no additional stats but plenty of bonuses.
Oblivion Crewmen are Forsaken located aboard The Oblivion in Stormheim.
__NOTOC__ Obsidian Charscales are black dragonspawn located in the Twilight Highlands.
Obsidian Crafting Fork drops from Searing Flame Harchek in the Waking Shores.
Observer Assistant Ata is a red dragonspawn located at Eon's Fringe in Thaldraszus.
Observer Koro is a blue drakonid located at Eon's Fringe in Thaldraszus.
Obsidian Cobraskin can occasionally be skinned from Elusive Magma Cobra in Zaralek Cavern.

The Obsidian Grand Cache is located in Zskera Vaults in the Forbidden Reach. It is reached by using Neltharion's Toolkit to repair the Broken Waygate in a cave at the Smoldering Perch in the Waking Shores. The chest is guarded by a Vault Weaver and a Vault Lurker. The contents reset weekly.
Observant Rat is a rat located in Obsidian Throne in the Waking Shores.
Obsidian Guard's Chausses drops from Assault of the Zaqali in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible.

Oglethorpe Obnoticus is an artisan gnomish engineering trainer located in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn. He teaches engineers Gnome Engineering. He is the creator of the OOX series of mechanical chickens.

An off tank (aka off-tank or offtank) is a player in a raid or party that concentrates on taking pressure off the main tank, usually by drawing off extra (usually weaker) mobs. Sometimes abbreviated to the acronym OT. Also known as a secondary tank. From [http://wow.allakhazam.com/db/guides.html?guide=470&mid=11328088444323 The Way of the Punch Bag - A Guide to Tanking v2.0] from Allakhazam: :A player that can safely and effectively tank one enemy. Depending on the situation and composition of your group, this may apply to anything from paladins to rogues or range-spec hunters.
